item.title: Guthrie to keynote ACA Connects Summit
item.description: Brett Guthrie (R-KY), the chairman of the House Energy and Commerce Committee, is set to keynote the ACA Connects annual Summit in Washington, DC. #pressrelease

item.title: Telefónica puts telco edge cloud to work
item.description: As it works towards deploying 17 edge nodes in Spain, Telefónica's head of telco edge computing outlines use cases, deployment tactics and the need for a non-siloed, federated approach to the telco edge cloud.

item.title: True arms Thai businesses with advanced digital services through SoftBank partnership
item.description: True Corporation has entered into a strategic partnership with Japan's SoftBank to jointly develop bespoke, industry-specific digital solutions for Thai businesses.

item.title: Open RAN faces life after multivendor death
item.description: The latest data from Dell'Oro is damning about open RAN's first incarnation, but it lives on in a tiny adjacent market.

item.title: Eurobites: Truespeed, Freedom Fibre agree to merge
item.description: Also in today's EMEA regional roundup: Swisscom Group prospers in Italy, struggles at home; UK telcos promise to be good; BT spreads the AI gospel.

item.title: Gaiia launches 'Workflow Builder' for ISPs
item.description: New drag-and-drop automation engine from gaiia is designed to streamline ISP service delivery, customer support and network workflows. #pressrelease

item.title: T-Mobile builds AI agents into 5G network to translate calls
item.description: T-Mobile integrates agentic AI into its core network to power voice call translation, and updates timing for AI RAN field trial later this year in preparation for 6G.

item.title: Rakuten Mobile hikes capex as its EBITDA leaves the red
item.description: Rakuten Mobile is increasing its capex to JPY200 billion (US$1.3 billion), saying it needs to speed up construction due to rising subscription numbers, as its EBITDA goes positive.

item.title: Charter trots out 'Invincible WiFi'
item.description: Charter has launched 'Invincible WiFi,' a service equipped with Wi-Fi 7 and 5G cellular and battery backup. It's bundled with the operator's 2-Gig service and available for $10 per month to 1-Gig customers and $20 per month to others #pressrelease

item.title: Optimum broadband sub losses worsen, video improves in Q4
item.description: Optimum saw broadband subscriber losses worsen to 62,200 in Q4 amid low churn and competition from fiber and FWA. Optimum intends to 'go on the offensive' in 2026 armed with simplified pricing and packaging, says CEO Dennis Mathew.
